subject: COLUMN clause
notes: Rule: printable-size = columns for the characters the PICTURE describes, or, with no PICTURE, the VALUE literal; one column per alphanumeric character (cite.py --check 13.18.14.4 'in the absence of a PICTURE clause, the literal specified in the VALUE clause' -> OK 3)). The emitter advances the horizontal counter by PrintItem.DisplayTextWidth. Probe p5.cob (2023) with each item followed by a relative '|': PIC 9(3)V99 -> 5 columns ('01234', V occupies none), PIC S999 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE -> 4 ('-012'), PIC -ZZ9.99 -> 7 ('- 12.34'), PIC S999 (embedded sign) -> 3, PIC N(2) -> 2: output '01234|-012|- 12.34|01K|AB|' - every boundary exact. Probe p1.cob: `COLUMN 3 VALUE "ABC"` (no PICTURE) occupied 3-5 and `COLUMN PLUS 2` then landed at 7. NOTE 1 is informative.
